verdict.rationale: Lium documents its own data-lifecycle controls. Pods can be set to auto-delete when a TTL, end time or spend cap is reached. Users choose whether data persists by mounting a Volume that outlives the pod. Local-volume backups are on by default with a fixed 2-day retention window. Retention durations are not user-configurable, and deletion of account-level or platform-held data is not documented. Missing for 10: configurable backup/retention periods, documented deletion of volumes, backups and account data, deletion guarantees or a privacy/retention policy, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Pick one, and the pod is deleted when it is reached: Hours... End time... Spend cap: a budget in USD
Mount a [Volume](./volumes) at `/mnt`. It keeps your data after the pod is deleted.
